sentences.text: 1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is accordingly disposed of.

3. The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:
"In view of the foregoing and in the interests of justice, it is humbly prayed before this Hon'ble Court to set aside the Order dated 12.01.2024 passed by Sh. Ankit Mehta , Ld.ASJ (POCSO), West, Tis Hazari Court in 'STATE VS GANESH' in case FIR no 373/2019 , P.S. Ranhola , U/s 376/506 IPC and Section 6 pocso act whereby the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. as filed by the petitioner was dismissed and also to grant one opportunity to Petitioner to cross examine prosecutrix."
4. Issue notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
